label: Chileautos

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Chileautos (carsales group) documents a stock and leads integration API for certified dealer integrators.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://www.chileautos.cl/staticpages/global-inventory-integration): Chileautos (carsales group) documents a stock and leads integration API for certified dealer integrators. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
